factions.name: Emberwick
factions.summary: The town at the Ashen Ford and the party's home. Built on ground still warm from the ember in the river; frightened, stubborn, and about to have a very hard winter.
goals: Survive the winter.
Keep the road east open.
Keep the warm ground warm.
factions.methods: A town council led by the mayor, a small guard, and a lot of arguing in the inn. Will pay adventurers in grain, coin and favours.
factions.secret: The council has known for years that the ember under the ford is fading, and has said nothing so that people would not leave.

factions.name: The Church of the Hearth
factions.summary: The Vale's church, which teaches that the Hearthflame was a gift of the gods to a deserving people and that its loss is a judgement.
goals: Keep the faithful through the cold.
Recover the embers for the church.
Keep the oldest scriptures closed.
factions.methods: Charity, sermons and the moral authority of three centuries. Its priests are mostly good people who have never read the oldest texts.
factions.secret: The church's founding scriptures describe the Crossing honestly: the fire was taken, not given. The high clergy have known for two centuries.

factions.name: The Kindled
factions.summary: A cult gathering the embers to relight the Hearthflame by feeding it lives. Its followers are mostly the hungry and the desperate, and many are genuinely kind.
goals: Gather all five embers in Ember Keep.
Relight the Hearthflame, whatever it costs.
Save the Vale.
factions.methods: Preaching in the hungry towns, buying shards through the Ash Market, and in the end sacrifice. Each life fed to the flame relights it brighter and redder.
factions.secret: Maren Sorrel is ember-touched and remembers the Hearth Age as if she lived it, because she carries hundreds of other people's burned memories. She believes she owes it to them.

factions.name: The Last Watch
factions.summary: All that is left of the Wardens: the undead Warden-Keeper and his oath-bound champion, holding a ruined keep against everyone for a hundred years.
goals: Keep the embers out of anyone's hands.
Finish what Oswin started on the night of the Fall.
factions.methods: The dead of the Keep, old Warden wards, and Ser Halvard's sword. Oswin speaks to no one; Halvard speaks for him.
factions.secret: Oswin wants the embers put out for good. He will help the party if they want the same, and destroy them if they do not.

factions.name: The Skarrow Clan
factions.summary: A goblin clan from the hills above the ford, driven down by the cold and the hunger. They hold the bridge because Emberwick locked its granaries.
goals: Feed the clan through the winter.
Take back the hunting grounds the Vale's farms swallowed in the Hearth Age.
factions.methods: Raids, tolls on the bridge, and hard bargaining. Mother Skarrow will talk; her warriors would rather not.
factions.secret: The clan's oldest songs remember the Vale before the Hearthflame, and the seven who crossed the Greywall. The goblins never forgot, because they never used the fire.

factions.name: Vorga's Host
factions.summary: A war band of goblins and hobgoblins who broke from the clans and took the Sunscar canyon bridge. They believe the Vale's towns will never share, so they mean to take.
goals: Hold the canyon road.
Raid the river towns before winter.
Prove the clans' old ways are dead.
factions.methods: Force, fortified bridges and ambushes from the canyon ridges.

factions.name: The Ash Market
factions.summary: The black market in ember shards, run from Emberwick's river docks. Everyone uses it; nobody admits to it.
goals: Buy shards cheap and sell them dear.
Stay useful to whoever wins.
factions.methods: Smuggling, bribery, and a very good memory for who owes what.
factions.secret: The Ash Market is selling the Kindled more shards than exist in the Vale. Someone is supplying them from beyond the Greywall.

factions.name: The Glimmer Court
factions.summary: The fey of Mirewood, who grew bright and strange around the ember that sank into the marsh. They think the ember is theirs now, and in a sense they are right.
goals: Keep the Mirewood ember.
Collect debts, favours and names.
Learn what mortals are willing to forget.
factions.methods: Bargains, riddles and glamours. A promise made in Mirewood is kept, one way or another.
factions.secret: The Court is made partly of burned memories. Take the ember and some of the fey will simply stop.

factions.name: The Scarwalkers
factions.summary: Nomads of the Sunscar, descended from the farmers whose fields the ember burned. They worship the crater where it fell and guard it from outsiders.
goals: Guard the Sunscar ember.
Never be driven out again.
factions.methods: Desert-craft, hospitality laws that bind both guest and host, and a long memory for those who broke them.
